_meta.description: IT operations language opportunity labels for SQL Server Operational Signal Pack.
_meta.status: Sprint 11 — pending SME sign-off before production
_meta.audience: IT Operations Manager, Service Desk Manager, CIO
_meta.compliance_note: Agent surfaces operational signals to IT managers only. No automated ticket resolution, SLA override, or priority change. All operational decisions require human approval.

DB_TICKET_VOLUME_SURGE.s6_why: Recent ticket intake is significantly above your 90-day average, suggesting an operational event or capacity gap that is not yet visible in SaaS systems.
DB_TICKET_VOLUME_SURGE.s6_action: An agent can monitor daily ticket intake against your baseline, surface surge alerts to IT managers before queues back up, and cross-reference with ServiceNow incident trends.

DB_SLA_BREACH_RATE.s6_why: More than 15% of tickets are breaching SLA in the last 30 days. This pattern typically precedes escalations and customer satisfaction impact.
DB_SLA_BREACH_RATE.s6_action: An agent can track SLA compliance in real time, alert assignment groups before breach occurs, and identify which ticket categories drive the highest breach rate.

DB_QUEUE_DEPTH_ELEVATED.s6_why: P1 and P2 open ticket counts are above safe operating levels. Elevated critical queue depth is a leading indicator of service disruption and SLA exposure.
DB_QUEUE_DEPTH_ELEVATED.s6_action: An agent can track P1/P2 queue depth in real time, alert the service desk manager when thresholds are approached, and flag tickets approaching their SLA deadline for proactive escalation.
